identity.name: Explorer II
identity.one_liner: The Explorer II of 1991-2011 in Polar white or black, 40mm.

narrative.story: The 16570 ran twenty years as the understated professional Rolex: 40mm, fixed steel 24-hour bezel, independently settable hour hand, and a choice of black or Polar white dials. Long overlooked next to Submariners and GMTs, it was repriced upward in the late 2010s as collectors worked through the five-digit references.
narrative.collector_notes: Late examples with caliber 3186 and 'rectangular lume' plots carry a premium. Polar dials show cream-versus-white aging clearly — original handsets matter.
